versions.changelog:
Initial release of btc-sovereign-tracker.

- Track COLDCARD Q vault health, mempool fee estimation, and watch-only BTC address balances/UTXOs.
- Fetch real-time fee and blockchain data from mempool.space and price info via CoinGecko.
- Identify and audit dust/consolidation candidates among UTXOs; recommend privacy-preserving practices.
- Designed for self-custody and sovereignty: requires only public info, never private keys.
- Compatible with Linux and macOS; requires `curl` and `jq`.
- Includes troubleshooting, privacy warnings, and principles for sovereign Bitcoin holders.
